vitest:GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp.title: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary file can be read and executed
vitest:GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp.reason: Dev-only, and only reachable with `vitest --ui`, which this repo never starts (tools/ci/check.sh runs plain `vitest run`). The fix needs vitest >=3.2.6; eight workspaces are pinned at ^2.0.0 and ^4.0.18, so clearing it is a vitest 2 -> 4 migration across the whole test suite, not a lockfile bump. Tracked as its own upgrade.

nanoid:GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8.title: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
nanoid:GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8.reason: Reached only through vite`s dev server (workspace:tm8-ui > vite). Not in any shipped bundle, and the loop needs a caller-supplied custom generator, which no tm8 code passes. Cleared by the same vite 5 -> 6.4.3+ upgrade as the vite advisories below.

vite:GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.title: vite: `server.fs.deny` bypass on Windows alternate paths
vite:GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.reason: Dev server only, Windows only. tm8 dev and CI both run on Linux, and no vite dev server is ever exposed off localhost. Needs vite >=6.4.3; packages/ui and packages/tm8-ui are on ^5.4.8, so this is a major vite upgrade with a matching @vitejs/plugin-react bump.

@babel/runtime:GHSA-968p-4wvh-cqc8.title: Babel has inefficient RegExp complexity in generated code with .replace when transpiling named capturing groups
@babel/runtime:GHSA-968p-4wvh-cqc8.reason: Test-only: reached through @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom and react-mentions. The regex blowup needs attacker-controlled input through transpiled named capture groups; test fixtures are repo-authored. Waiting on those three packages to widen their @babel/runtime range.

dompurify:GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7.title: DOMPurify: IN_PLACE hook removal leaves a detached subtree executable, causing XSS
dompurify:GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7.reason: Reached through mermaid (already bumped to 11.16.1 here, which is the newest release). mermaid pins dompurify ^3.3.3 and no published mermaid yet depends on a fixed 3.4.13+. tm8 renders mermaid only from repo-authored diagram source, not user input. Re-check when mermaid ships the bump.

esbuild:GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.title: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response
esbuild:GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.reason: Dev server only — esbuild arrives transitively through vite. Same vite 5 -> 6.4.3+ upgrade; esbuild cannot be bumped on its own without pinning an override that vite would then disagree with.

vite:GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.title: Vite Vulnerable to Path Traversal in Optimized Deps `.map` Handling
vite:GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9.reason: Dev server only; same vite 5 -> 6.4.3+ upgrade as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.

vite:GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3.title: launch-editor: NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling on Windows
vite:GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3.reason: Dev server only, Windows only (UNC path handling in launch-editor). Same vite 5 -> 6.4.3+ upgrade as GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff.
